question: What is the meaning of lifetime (years) in relation to material information?
description: The lifetime (years) in relation to material information refers to the expected lifespan of a product or system used in a building, which is often referred to as Reference Service Life (RSL). This information is crucial for conducting further assessments, such as Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) or Life Cycle Cost (LCC), and aids in planning maintenance, refurbishment, or disassembly tasks. The RSL can indicate when a material product or system can be taken out of a building and recommissioned.
